newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price - USDA.

text.p: USDA reported Tuesday that around 3,500 head were exported into the United States at two crossing points Monday.
Through Santa Teresa, New Mexico, around 2,500 head were sold at steady prices for yearlings and steer calves.
"Trade moderate, demand good. Bulk of supply consisted of steers weighing 300-500 lb. Supply included several lots of corriente steers" USDA said.
Prices for 300-400 lb feeder steers were between 78-88 cents /lb and for 400-500 lb head they were between 70-78 cents/lb.
Through Laredo, Texas, around 1,000 head were sold at steady prices. "Trade and demand moderate, " USDA said.
Prices for 300-400 lb feeders ranged between 77-87 cents/lb and for 400-500 ln head they were between 68-77 cents/lb.
